description: This file contains class definitions and constructor implementations for RNN and GRU options used in PyTorch's neural network module, specifically for handling RNN, LSTM, and GRU configurations.

classes.name: RNNOptionsBase
classes.description: Base class for RNN options, holding mode, input size, and hidden size.

classes.name: RNNOptions
classes.description: Class to specify options for RNN layers, including input and hidden sizes.

classes.name: LSTMOptions

classes.name: GRUOptions
classes.description: Class to specify options for GRU layers, including input and hidden sizes.

classes.name: RNNCellOptionsBase
classes.description: Base class for RNN cell options, including input size, hidden size, bias, and number of chunks.

classes.name: RNNCellOptions
classes.description: Class for RNN cell options, specifying input size and hidden size.

classes.name: LSTMCellOptions
classes.description: Class for LSTM cell options, specifying input size and hidden size.

classes.name: GRUCellOptions
classes.description: Class for GRU cell options, specifying input size and hidden size.
